items.title: 68190_Samuel
items.q: Then I know you had that great gig down at the Holiday Inn with Fatts Dennis and [Elsie]L.C. Carr on piano.

ctx.x: And after Bob Ford's, I was just trying to think, I'm sure I caught you somewhere. Then I know you had that great gig down at the Holiday Inn with Fatts Dennis and [Elsie]L.C. Carr on piano.
